task: Preserve immutable release-unit operation semantics across trusted fully-already-applied successor reevaluation while allowing only monotonic fresh governance/proof enrichment required by current Atlas authority.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Release Unit Execution #244 replayed immutable parent source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 on main 42e80eed290f2cd5b5baa1a677e021a8a074ee12 after the governed U03 conflict resolution merged. U03 materialization is now fully already-applied, but fresh successor Plan/Atlas projection reclassifies the original sealed fixture-25 create as modify solely because the exact source-identical file is already present on main, and it adds newer dependency/read-only governance obligations. Raw obligation comparison therefore emits RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_OBLIGATION_DRIFT before the canonical no-code already-applied proof can run. The fix must preserve immutable operation semantics only when the trusted pre-projection materialization proves the whole unit ALREADY_APPLIED, while allowing only additive dependency/read-only governance enrichment under trusted fresh projection provenance.
observableOutcomes: A successor whose trusted pre-projection materialization is fully ALREADY_APPLIED keeps the persisted immutable operation types instead of reclassifying create as modify from current-main existence.
The preserved operations retain the same sealed source commit, blob SHA and file mode after resealing.

Additive requiredDependencyFiles and readOnlyPaths discovered by fresh canonical Plan/Atlas projection are classified as reprojectable governance enrichment only when reconciliation has trustedFreshProjection=true.
Dependency/read-only removal, replacement or scope weakening remains material obligation drift.

Partial materialization, forged ALREADY_APPLIED coverage, generated unsupported semantics, operation path/type mutation, source commit/blob/fileMode mutation and forged operation digest remain fail-closed.
Immutable rehearsal replay advances U03 into canonical ALREADY_APPLIED no-code proof without editing the stale U03 PR or persisted release-state by hand.
unresolvedRisks: Treating every create-to-modify transition as harmless would allow semantic mutation without proving current main already contains the immutable source object.
Preserving operations for partially applied units could hide work still needing materialization.
Making dependency/read-only drift generically reprojectable could silently remove required protection if subtraction were allowed.
Fresh child plan and manifest operation semantics could diverge unless operation preservation is limited to fully already-applied trusted materialization.
A stale or forged materialization receipt must not authorize operation preservation.

in: Preserve reconciled immutable operations during successor reevaluation only when trusted materializeReleaseUnit returns status ALREADY_APPLIED with exact full operation coverage and no applied operations.
Allow monotonic additive requiredDependencyFiles and readOnlyPaths obligation enrichment to be reprojectable.
Require trustedFreshProjection for all such governance enrichment at reconciliation.
Add regression coverage for exact full already-applied preservation and all fail-closed variants.
Keep existing first-sealing provenance and exact-create main-advance guards unchanged.
out: No manual U03 child PR edit.
No Truth, Sentinel, threshold, release-risk or lifecycle bypass.
No storefront, template, Supabase or deployment change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This reconciliation decides whether immutable release-unit obligations may survive a current-main state that already contains their exact effect. A false positive could erase required work or weaken dependency closure, so only trusted full ALREADY_APPLIED coverage plus monotonic governance enrichment is admissible.

acceptanceCriteria: The pre-projection candidate must have status ALREADY_APPLIED, applied=[] and exact one-for-one operation+file coverage before persisted operations may be preserved.
Preserved operations come from the reconciled immutable manifest, not from reconstructed current-main operation inference.
Fresh canonical source sealing must still validate source commit/blob/fileMode for every preserved non-delete operation.
Additive requiredDependencyFiles may reproject; any removal or replacement remains material.
Additive readOnlyPaths may reproject; any removal or replacement remains material.
Reprojectable governance drift is rejected when trustedFreshProjection is absent.
Existing first-sealing, resealing, semantic mutation, forged digest, exact-create overlap and main-drift tests remain green.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge.
Post-merge immutable source replay advances beyond RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_OBLIGATION_DRIFT and reaches U03 no-code proof/closure.
invariants: Immutable operation type/path/source identity remains the release-unit authority.
ALREADY_APPLIED is evidence of exact current-main effect, not permission to rewrite the obligation.
Governance enrichment may only add constraints; it may not subtract or replace them.
Trusted fresh projection is mandatory for accepting governance enrichment.
Persisted release-state is changed only by the canonical executor.

failureModes: Candidate is partially applied but operation preservation is incorrectly enabled.
ALREADY_APPLIED coverage omits or duplicates an operation.
Fresh projection removes an existing dependency and classifier treats it as enrichment.
Fresh projection removes a read-only protection and classifier treats it as enrichment.
Operation preservation keeps a stale source identity after immutable source changed.
No-code proof receives a manifest whose operations no longer match the trusted materialization receipt.
edgeCases: single exact create already present with identical blob and mode
create target present with different blob
mixed create and conflict-resolved modify both already applied
one operation already applied and one operation still materializes
first sealing and already-applied preservation occurring in the same successor cycle

alternatives.summary: Keep reconciled immutable operation semantics when the trusted candidate materialization proves exact full-unit ALREADY_APPLIED, while separately accepting only monotonic governance enrichment.
alternatives.reason: Preserves release-unit intent and uses existing materializer Git-object proof rather than inferring semantic equivalence from filenames.

alternatives.summary: Treat create and modify as equivalent whenever the file already exists.
alternatives.reason: Would allow semantic operation drift without immutable target identity proof.
Would destroy immutable source and material-operation integrity.

alternatives.summary: Edit persisted U03 release-state so execution skips reconciliation.
alternatives.reason: Would bypass canonical executor authority and resumability truth.

specialistReviews.finding: Operation semantics must not become a function of mutable current-main existence.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preserve the reconciled immutable operation list only after the trusted materializer proves full already-applied coverage.

specialistReviews.finding: A broad create-to-modify exception would be forgeable.
specialistReviews.resolution: No operation-drift exception is added; exact already-applied evidence prevents the drift from being introduced.

specialistReviews.finding: Dependency/read-only refresh must not weaken closure.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only strict additive enrichment is reprojectable; subtraction remains material.

specialistReviews.finding: The current blocker is before no-code proof despite exact U03 effects already living on main.
specialistReviews.resolution: Allow canonical successor reconciliation to retain immutable ops and then run the existing no-code proof unchanged.

specialistReviews.finding: Execution #244 is reproducible from immutable source 65e52ffd and main 42e80eed.
specialistReviews.resolution: Regression tests encode the exact full-already-applied and monotonic-enrichment boundaries.

challenge.scenario: Fresh Plan sees an immutable create target already present and labels it modify.
challenge.finding: Current existence describes repository state, not original release-unit intent.
challenge.resolution: When full ALREADY_APPLIED is trusted, preserve the reconciled immutable create operation.

challenge.scenario: Only one of two operations is already applied.
challenge.finding: Preserving all original operations would hide remaining material work.
challenge.resolution: Require candidate.status ALREADY_APPLIED, applied=[] and exact full coverage; PREPARED/APPLIED candidates use projected operations normally.

challenge.scenario: Fresh Atlas adds a dependency and read-only proof path.
challenge.finding: This strengthens current governance but changes raw manifest JSON.
challenge.resolution: Classify additive-only sets as reprojectable and still require trustedFreshProjection.

challenge.scenario: Fresh projection removes a dependency or read-only path.
challenge.finding: This weakens closure and could conceal drift.
challenge.resolution: Keep subtraction/replacement material and fail closed.

challenge.scenario: Sealed source blob or file mode changes while target happens to exist.
challenge.finding: Already-applied state cannot authorize source identity mutation.
challenge.resolution: Existing sealing and operation digest guards remain material and unchanged.

challenge.scenario: Caller fabricates additive governance drift without trusted fresh projection.
Full ALREADY_APPLIED coverage is exact, but the fresh projection regenerates a different child operation digest from current-main inferred operation types.
challenge.finding: Accepting the regenerated digest would silently replace immutable operation identity even though no material work remains.
challenge.resolution: Preserve reconciled immutable operations before final sealing so operationDigest remains derived from the original semantic operations; any residual digest mismatch remains material.

challenge.scenario: Fresh projection adds a read-only path that is also an intended operation path.
challenge.finding: Calling this additive governance enrichment would conflict with the manifest's own material scope and could mask a forbidden operation.
challenge.resolution: Existing forbiddenHits/readOnly validation remains authoritative before drift classification; an operation captured by readOnlyPaths blocks rather than reprojects.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS before runtime edits.
Add a pure exact full-coverage selector for successor projected operations and test full/partial/forged cases.
Use the selector inside reevaluateSuccessorManifest before final sealing.
Extend obligation classification with monotonic additive-set enrichment for requiredDependencyFiles and readOnlyPaths only.
Add trusted/untrusted and subtraction regression tests.
Require exact-head Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Replay/Release Risk/Quality/TypeScript/Build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle proof.
Merge only after exact PR-head SUCCESS and green main CI.
Replay immutable source SHA 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 and require U03 ALREADY_APPLIED proof, unit close, parent Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure.

requirements.requirement: Trusted successor reevaluation must preserve immutable release-unit operation semantics when the whole unit is already applied, while accepting only monotonic fresh governance enrichment and retaining fail-closed source/dependency integrity.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A create operation may not become modify merely because its path exists on current main unless full trusted ALREADY_APPLIED materialization has already proven the exact unit effect.
Required dependency or read-only obligations may not be removed under successor reprojection.
Additive governance enrichment may not be accepted without trusted fresh projection provenance.
Already-applied successor handling may not accept source commit/blob/fileMode or forged operation-digest mutation.

notes: Live blocker: Release Unit Execution #244 on immutable source 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65 and main 42e80eed290f2cd5b5baa1a677e021a8a074ee12. Persisted U03 has sealed create fixture-25 + sealed modify production-surface test. Governed main resolution already contains both exact effects; trusted materializer therefore produces full ALREADY_APPLIED. Fresh Plan/Atlas projection then describes fixture-25 as modify because it now exists and adds scripts/release-unit-github-runtime.mjs as dependency plus current read-only proof paths, causing raw operations/dependency/readOnly/childOperationDigest obligation drift before no-code proof. This task preserves immutable operation semantics only under exact full ALREADY_APPLIED evidence and permits only additive governance enrichment under trusted fresh projection. No persisted release-state or immutable source mutation is authorized.
